spans.s: प्रधन n. 1. Fight, war, battle, क्षत्रं क्षत्रप्रधनपिशुनं कौरवं तद्भजेथाः Megh.i.48, R.xi.77; 2. spoil taken in battle; 3. destroying, destruction.
प्रधान (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Chief, principal, preeminent, most excellent, M.vii.203; 2. prevalent, predominant.
प्रधान (II) m.n. 1. The first attendant of a king (either his minister or confidant); 2. a courtier; 3. an elephant-driver.
प्रधान (III) n. 1. The chief object, the head, the chief, प्रधानं तीर्थानाममलपरिधानं त्रिजगतः G.
; 2. the primary germ out of whioh the material world is evolved (in Sāṅkhya phil.), अनुमाननिरूपितमपि प्रधानमेकेषां शाखिनां शब्दवदुपलभ्यते S.Bh.i.; (See प्रकृति); 3. the supreme spirit; 4. intellect.
प्रधान (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Chief, principal, preeminent, most excellent, M.vii.203; 2. prevalent, predominant.
प्रधमन n. 1. Blowing in or into; 2. a sternutatory.
प्रधर्ष m. Assaulting, assailing.
प्रधर्षण n. 1. Attack, assault; 2. ill-treatment.
प्रधर्षणा f. 1. Attack, assault; 2. ill-treatment.
प्रधर्षित a. (f. ता) 1. Attacked; 2. haughty, arrogant.
प्रधर्षित a. (f. ता) 1. Attacked; 2. haughty, arrogant.
प्रधान-अंग n. 1. the principal part of anything; 2. the chief member of the body; 3. the most eminent person in a state.
प्रधान-अमात्य m. a prime minister.
प्रधान-आत्मन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्रधान-धातु m. the chief element of the body, i.e. semen virile.
प्रधान-पुरुष m. 1. the most distinguished personage; 2. an epithet of Śiva.
प्रधान-मंत्रिन् m. a prime minister.
प्रधान-वासस् n. an excellent garment.
प्रधान-वृष्टि f. heaviest rain.
प्रधावन (I) m. Air, wind.
प्रधावन (II) n. Rubbing, rubbing off, washing off.
प्रधि m. 1. The periphery of a wheel; 2. a well.
प्रधी (I) a. Preeminently intelligent.
प्रधी (II) f. Great intelligence.
प्रधूपित a. (f. ता) 1. Heated, burned; 2. perfumed, fumigated; 3. afflicted.
प्रधूपित a. (f. ता) 1. Heated, burned; 2. perfumed, fumigated; 3. afflicted.
प्रधूपिता f. 1. The quarter to wnich the sun is proceeding; 2. a woman in trouble.
प्रधृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Treated with contumely; 2. proud, arrogant.
प्रधृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Treated with contumely; 2. proud, arrogant.
प्रध्यान n. Deep thought, reflection.
प्रध्वंस m. Utter destruction, total annihilation.
प्रध्वंस-अभाव m. nonexistence on account of annihilation, nonexistence of something which existed before (in logic).
प्रध्वस्त a. (f. स्ता) Annihilated, destroyed.
प्रध्वस्त a. (f. स्ता) Annihilated, destroyed.
प्राधनिक n. A destructive weapon.
प्राधानिक a. (f. की) 1. Most eminent, most excellent, most distinguished; 2. derived from Pradhāna q.v. (in Sāṅkhya phil.)
प्राधानिक a. (f. की) 1. Most eminent, most excellent, most distinguished; 2. derived from Pradhāna q.v. (in Sāṅkhya phil.)
प्राधान्य n. 1. preeminence, superiority, predominance; 2. a chief cause.(प्राधान्येन, प्राधान्यात्, प्राधान्यतस् ‘chiefly, principally,’ Bg.x.19.)
प्राधीत a. (f. ता) Well-read, thoroughly educated.
प्राधीत a. (f. ता) Well-read, thoroughly educated.
प्राध्व (I) a. (f. ध्वा) 1. Distant, remote, a long way off; 2. bent, inclined; 3. tied, fastened; 4. favourable.
प्राध्व (II) m. A carriage.(प्राध्वम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) favourably, सभाजने मे भुजमूर्ध्वबाहुः सव्येतरं प्राध्वमितः प्रयुंक्ते R.xiii.43; (2) crookedly.)
प्राध्व (I) a. (f. ध्वा) 1. Distant, remote, a long way off; 2. bent, inclined; 3. tied, fastened; 4. favourable.
